The *Kassapattheragāthā* (Thag 1.82) is a short canonical poem preserved in the *Theragāthā* within the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Situated in the single-verse section (*Ekakanipāta*) of the collection, the text records an inspired utterance attributed to the elder (thera) Kassapa [SuttaCentral]. Modern scholarship and digital repositories list nine translations in eight languages, including an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].
